name: drawdown_adaptive_5s
author: adapted from claude-4.6-opus-agent-4
thesis: During drawdown periods, reducing position size preserves capital for recovery; during equity growth periods, increasing size compounds gains. By tracking the strategy's intraday equity curve and scaling positions based on current drawdown from session high-water mark, we implement an anti-martingale approach: full size at zero drawdown, 75% at 0.3% drawdown, 50% at 0.6% drawdown, and flat at 1% drawdown (daily loss limit). The base signal is a Supertrend + VWAP trend-following system. The inefficiency exists because most traders use fixed sizing throughout the day regardless of their P&L, or worse, increase size after losses (martingale), which is mathematically suboptimal for finite capital.
mechanism: Market microstructure varies across volatility regimes. In low-vol regimes, mean-reversion dominates as market makers provide tight liquidity. In high-vol regimes, momentum persists as liquidity thins and stop-cascades amplify moves. Adapting the signal to the current regime captures the appropriate edge for prevailing conditions.

filters.vix_filter: India VIX < 25; start at Size_Scale * 0.75 if VIX > 20

weaknesses: The strategy reduces size after losses, which means if the market regime recovers, it catches the recovery with smaller size — the best trading periods may follow drawdowns, and we're under-positioned
Size_Scale step function creates discontinuities — at 0.29% drawdown the size is ₹1L, at 0.31% it drops to ₹75K; a single additional loss triggers a 25% size cut that may be premature
Starting capital assumption for DD_Pct calculation is ambiguous for intraday — is it session starting capital (₹5L?) or per-trade capital (₹1L)? This affects threshold calibration significantly
prior_art: Anti-martingale position sizing in Jones's 'The Trading Game'; drawdown control in Tharp's position sizing; maximum drawdown constraints in portfolio optimization (Chekhlov et al. 2005)
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; signal conversion from individual stock to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index; lookback period scaling for 5-second bars. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
